the_signal.headline: Semantic chunking now beats fixed-size RAG splits—cost and accuracy
the_signal.body: RAG quality isn't just about the model anymore—it's about how you chunk your knowledge base. Semantic chunking preserves context, cuts token costs, and improves retrieval accuracy in production. For GTM teams deploying AI agents on customer data, this is the difference between agents that hallucinate and agents that close deals.
